fields.description: Talay is the 167-villa neighbourhood at the heart of Marsa Al Saadiyat. Its four- to six-bedroom homes pair private gardens with a network of shared green spaces. The separate Talay Beach collection has its own sizes and delivery target.

overview: Aldar's first Marsa Al Saadiyat release uses landscaped paths, shaded gathering spaces and water channels inspired by local irrigation traditions. Artist Abdalla Almulla contributes architectural details and a fountain. The wider destination includes planned cultural, education and waterfront infrastructure; those facilities have separate delivery programmes.
research.locationNote: The villas sit within Marsa Al Saadiyat on Saadiyat Island. Confirm the exact plot, beach access route and opening dates of announced schools and transport links.
research.priceNote: The Aldar fact sheet quotes AED 13.5m. Impala's launch breakdown lists five-bedroom homes from AED 15.5m and six-bedroom homes from AED 17.2m. These are historical launch references, not a current stock quotation.
research.paymentNote: The fact sheet states 50/50. The detailed dates below are reported by Impala from its launch pack; January and June 2029 have no confirmed day of month. Obtain the current contractual schedule.
research.handoverNote: The reviewed fact sheet estimates handovers commencing Q4 2029 for Talay. Individual delivery and possession conditions remain subject to the sale agreement.
